scope: Read-only comparison of all65 modeled primary champion records and the five previously missing alternate-form asset names in installed live/PBE Set18 and Common WAD decodes.
comparisonMethod: Mapped primary asset names through the live canonical-path index, confirmed presence in both decodes, compared original BIN hashes and complete decoded SpellObject blocks, and compared root stats/resource values plus spell timing/flags/main DataValues/calculation counts to saved public JSON. Numeric JSON/float32 comparisons allow1e-6relative tolerance; no default is invented for omitted properties.
resourceFieldCaution: Changes to primaryAbilityResource.0x726ee5cd.baseValue are reported literally. This field follows mana-cap-like values, but unknown field semantics, omitted defaults and active runtime behavior are not independently certified here.
pinnedInterpretation: These installations are different builds. New PBE values are observations, not authorization or sufficient evidence to replace the pinned18.1d rules. Existing pinned Riot patch overrides already account for Draven AS, Elder AD and Yi resists.

missingDataNotContradictions.detail: Installed primary AP asset AD30 matches the equipped AP kit. The normalized root AD45 is a form join, not a conflict.
Character record omits baseDamageModifiable. This does not establish zero attack damage or contradict the lookup-derived10AD.

unresolvedQuestions.evidence: 63 of65 main spells have the same generic DataValue/OtherValue templates in both installations and the public mirror. Alune and Kobuko retain other named fields already seen publicly; they do not establish the current Set18 ability formulas.

unresolvedQuestions.topic: Yorick AD icon versus AP strike calculation
unresolvedQuestions.evidence: Installed Yorick main spell is a generic template. It supplies no usable strike coefficient or scaling rule to choose between the pinned conflicting sources.

unresolvedQuestions.topic: Akali reset timing, Brambleback Frenzy stacking, Azir command-window mana lock
unresolvedQuestions.evidence: No new active script or runtime rule appears in the installed character records; generic cast flags do not establish these mechanics.

unresolvedQuestions.topic: AoE shape and independent target counts
unresolvedQuestions.evidence: Template radius/range and visual spell data do not prove active targeting or damage distribution. Existing nearest-N and wave-emission findings still require source/runtime work.

All inspected timing fields match the public exports, and every decoded SpellObject is identical between live and PBE. Static windup/missile/ratio metadata still needs proof of active TFT use before changing the event engine.

None of the five requested alternate asset names appears in any of the1234 decoded Set18/Common files; no corresponding canonical path appears in the live index. This does not mean the game lacks those forms: runtime data or another asset name/location may supply them.

context: Local comparison performed after the root agent copied authorized static Mac game assets over SSH. remoteAccessUsedByThisFollowup refers only to the local comparison worker.
